framings.text: A human-first system compounds its own rigor, durability, cohesion, and verification while helping a restaurateur judge a delicious final product—from intuition through a PR ready for human review and an easier-to-change code base.

supports.quote: system that compounds itself and serves as a meta harness
I am the resterauntaur that tastes the final delicious product
all the way to a PR that is ready to be reviewed by human

framings.text: A human-first board coordinates the entire continuum of agentic software development lifecycle, connecting brain dumps, prompts, hunches, and intuition to verified PRs while the restaurateur remains the final judge.

supports.quote: its a human first board for coordinainting work from the entire continuum of agentic software development lifecycle
this part (the brain dump-the prompt-the hunch-the intuition)
it should operate like a michellin star resteraunt

outcome: The restaurateur experiences a human-first system that turns a brain dump, prompt, hunch, or intuition into a delicious final product: a PR ready for human review, with the code base’s health considered and its next change made easier.

questions.text: Does “compounds itself” primarily mean the harness improves itself, the code base becomes easier to change, or both?

alternatives.label: Board-centered coordination
alternatives.benefit: Keeps the human-first board and restaurateur’s final judgment central across the lifecycle.
alternatives.cost: May leave more execution and verification distributed across the workflow.

alternatives.label: End-to-end meta harness
alternatives.benefit: Creates a more continuous path from intuition to verified PR and future code-base health.
alternatives.cost: May require stronger assumptions about automation and coordination.
